purpose.summary: This program is part of the ORCA (JMA standard receipt software) Japanese medical billing system. It handles the screen logic for setting up hospital-specific admission fee (入院料) information, including selection ranges, fee classification, tax classification, and validity date ranges. It is a screen-driven subprogram called via a window manager (MCP) framework.
purpose.domain: healthcare / medical billing (Japanese national health insurance claims)

notable_features: Japanese-language comments encoded in Latin-1 (actually EUC-JP or Shift-JIS, decoded as Latin-1 producing mojibake)
MCP (screen/window manager) framework with MCP-STATUS and MCP-EVENT evaluation
Extensive use of COPY statements for shared data structures (.INC files)
OCCURS 400 table for hospital department list items
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — uses custom DB access via COPY/CALL pattern
LINKAGE SECTION with multiple areas (MCPAREA, SPAAREA, LINKAREA, SCRAREA)
Open Source license header (JMA Open Source License)
verdict.notes: The file is genuine production COBOL from the open-source ORCA Japanese medical receipt software project (circa 2002-2004). Comments are in Japanese (EUC-JP or Shift-JIS) but were decoded as Latin-1, resulting in garbled display. The dialect is most consistent with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL targeting Linux, as ORCA is known to use. The 5 lines slightly over 72 characters are minor and typical of this codebase. No embedded SQL or CICS; database access is abstracted through COPY/CALL-based MCP framework.
